role: Client-side static HUD state for the boss health bar: the health fraction, the boss name, the bar timer and the damage tint flag, set from the boss renderer each frame.
scope_reason: C4: the dragon's boss bar and name.

members.name: healthScale
members.note: client boss bar only, no native counterpart

members.name: statusBarTime
members.note: client boss bar only, no native counterpart

members.name: bossName
members.note: client boss bar only, no native counterpart

members.name: hasColorModifier
members.note: only the wither sets it true; the wither is switched off

members.name: setBossStatus
members.note: called from RenderDragon.doRender and RenderWither.doRender in vanilla; no native counterpart

members.name: BossStatus
members.note: n/a: a static-only class; nothing in oracle/src constructs it (no new BossStatus())

members.name: setBossStatus
members.note: runs only when a frame is drawn (the row replays draw none): covframes' frame coverage runs it in cf-idx-dragondeath-s42 (RenderDragon.doRender)

notes: No native counterpart anywhere: the live HUD JSON emitter (csrc/engine/hud_live.c:raster_hud_live_json) writes a constant "boss":null,"bosst":0,"bossh" field, which is a placeholder, not a port of this class. The wither side of setBossStatus is additionally moot because world.conf has wither = off. Not verified: nothing beyond the greps of oracle/src and csrc/engine.
